post.summary: Debug command to executes the serial diagnosis check of the ADC IP core.
post.description: Endpoint to perform the serial diagnosis check of the ADC. This will communicate with the ADC IC and read out some specified default values. If those values are transmitted correctly, the ADC interface check passes.

post.summary: Debug command to streams motor measurement data.
post.description: Endpoint to perform a motor measurement data streaming based on the specified channels and number of samples. It links the VIO clock signal to the ADC trigger and streams the data to a memory stream. If the streaming is successful, it returns the data as a file result. In case of errors or cancellation, appropriate status codes and messages are returned.

post.summary: Debug command to set the motor controller mode.
post.description: Endpoint to set the mode of the motor controller. The mode can be one of the predefined modes such as 'Config', 'Manual', 'EcIe', 'DC', 'EcHs', or 'EcSl'. The mode is changed through the motor controller service.

post.summary: Debug command to start the motor.
post.description: Endpoint to start the motor using the motor controller service with the specified direction and mode. Depending on the mode parameter, it sets the motor controller to the specified config mode. Depending on the direction parameter, it starts the motor in either clockwise (CW) or counterclockwise (CCW) direction.

post.summary: Debug command to stop the motor.
post.description: Endpoint to stop the motor using the motor controller service.

post.summary: Debug command to brake the motor.
post.description: Endpoint to brake the motor by shorting the windings using the motor controller service.

post.summary: Debug command to release motor braking.
post.description: Endpoint to stop motor braking using the motor controller service.

get.summary: Debug command to get the current state of the motor controller.
get.description: Endpoint to read the current state of the motor controller, including the version, actual mode, control register and firmware states.

post.summary: Debug command to clear any motor controller errors.
post.description: Endpoint to clear any motor controller errors using the motor controller service.

post.summary: Debug command to toggle between 'HS mode' and 'SL mode'.
post.description: Endpoint to toggle the motor controller mode between HS (hall sensor) and SL (Sensorless). It throws an exception if its not possible to change the mode.

post.summary: Debug command to write motor parameters.
post.description: Endpoint to write motor parameters to the motor controller. The parameters are retrieved by deserializing the provided JSON string.

get.summary: Debug command to read motor parameters.
get.description: Endpoint to read motor parameters from the motor controller. The parameters are serialized to a JSON format.

post.summary: Debug command to set a new motor voltage set point.

post.summary: Debug command to set up the motor controller carrier.
post.description: Endpoint to set up the motor controller carrier by enabling the hall supply and setting the DC voltage and current sensing gains.

post.summary: Debug command to clean up the motor controller carrier.
post.description: Endpoint to cleans up the motor controller carrier by disabling the hall supply and resetting the DC voltage and current sensing gains to their default values.

get.summary: Debug command to get the current state of the motor controller carrier.
get.description: Endpoint to read the current state of the motor controller carrier, including the DC voltage and current sensing gains and the hall supply state.
